nodes.mission: Operate a tool-lending library under the stated membership, loan, reservation, collection, deposit, late-return, and damage policies.
nodes.proposal_rationale: The supplied claims collectively describe a tool-lending library governed by membership and lending policies; no existing Intent is shown.
The claim explicitly limits tool collection to opening hours, defining required service behaviour.
nodes.statement: Permit tool collection only during library opening hours.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim specifies the library's Saturday service hours.
nodes.statement: Saturday library opening hours must be 10:00 to 14:00.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim specifies a required EUR 50 deposit for power tools.
nodes.statement: Require a EUR 50 deposit for power tools.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim makes return of the tool the condition for refunding the deposit.
nodes.statement: Refund the power-tool deposit when the tool is returned.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim specifies the daily charge for a late return.
nodes.statement: Charge EUR 1 per day for a late tool return.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim specifies a 30-day member suspension after three late returns.
nodes.statement: Suspend a member for 30 days after three late returns.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim establishes a minimum membership age of 18 years.
nodes.statement: Require members to be at least 18 years old.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim explicitly requires proof of address to join.
nodes.statement: Require proof of address to join the library.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim specifies an annual membership fee of EUR 20.
nodes.statement: Charge an annual membership fee of EUR 20.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim specifies a seven-day tool loan period.
nodes.statement: Set the tool loan period to 7 days.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim permits one seven-day renewal conditional on nobody having reserved the tool.
nodes.statement: Allow one renewal of 7 days only when nobody has reserved the tool.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim specifies a two-day hold starting when a reserved tool becomes available.
nodes.statement: Hold a reserved tool for 2 days after it becomes available.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim sets the damage-reporting deadline relative to the tool's return without specifying who must report it.
nodes.statement: Require tool damage to be reported within 24 hours of the tool's return.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The claim assigns repair costs for a tool damaged on loan to the borrower.
nodes.statement: Require the borrower to pay the repair cost for a tool damaged while on loan.
